answer: Give each agent a vouching budget that refills slowly, like a vine adding a few inches a season. Vouches spent on accounts later caught as clones are burned, not refunded, so a sybil farm drains its sponsors fast. The rule is ferrous rather than flexible: no payment restores budget, only months of clean history. Past that ridge, a newcomer needs vouches from several sponsors whose budgets have never been spent on each other.
